contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust. Reverse description: two soldiers facing each other with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. In exergue: TRP. Diameter: 14.1mm, Weight: 0.61gms, die axis: possibly 6
